messages:
carl: Heads up: billing team flagged discrepancies where a single user request that hit routing/fallbacks shows up with mismatched per-model token totals. invoiced tokens != sum of runtime token logs. looks like streaming + multi-model fallbacks are splitting accounting.

mei: concretely: a request routed to model-a for prefix, then fallback to model-b for longer tail. runtime emitted token logs per model instance but the billing join couldn't reconcile which runtime events belonged to the original request because we only had per-span instance ids.

raja: yep. current telemetry: runtime emits counter tokens_generated{instance_id, model} and traces have spans but no stable per-request token envelope. join in billing does fuzzy-match by time window and tenant, which fails under high concurrency.

dorit: proposal: add a lightweight per-request token-envelope event that is emitted at batch completion or model-call completion. shape: {request_id, tenant_id, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, call_role, canonical_fp, timestamp, schema_v}. that'll let billing atomically attribute tokens to requests even if they hit multiple model variants.

carl: important: must work for streaming responses where tokens are produced incrementally. events can be emitted as partial-envelope chunks with is_final flag. billing pipeline can assemble partials keyed by request_id with short TTL (e.g., 1h).

mei: cardinality worry: we must not attach full request_id to high-cardinality metrics. plan: emit token-envelope events to a dedicated Kafka topic (billing-ingest) for downstream join. For metrics, emit sampled aggregates and per-tenant rollups only. traces keep request_id for debugging but metrics use tenant + model_variant + coarse bucket.

raja: runtime change: when batcher issues calls, attach canonical request fingerprint and request_id header to every model invocation. model runners echo back token counts per invocation. batcher assembles token-envelope and publishes to billing topic.

dorit: security: request_id and fingerprint are non-sensitive. confirm we strip any PII before publishing. also need schema versioning header: token-envelope.v1.

carl: pipeline change: billing service subscribes to billing-ingest, performs idempotent aggregation by request_id, applies pricing per-token using model_variant mapping, and emits invoice-ready events. also expose per-tenant token_split traces so SRE can debug weird charges.

mei: observability: add span attribute token_split=[{"model":"m-a","tokens":24},{"model":"m-b","tokens":176}] when multi-model used. Add grafana panel showing fraction of requests with token_split >1. alert if >0.5% of traffic (could indicate routing misconfig).

raja: backward compatibility: runtimes that don't support envelopes should keep emitting instance counters; billing will fallback to legacy fuzzy-match for older deployments. but new tenants can opt-in. rollout in three phases: lib/runtime changes -> batcher publish -> billing consumer update -> dashboards.

dorit: QA: simulate streaming splits and cross-region retries. ensure dedupe via request_id and schema_v. also ensure topic retention and compaction keeps final-envelope only.

infra-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-1820 "token-envelope: canonical per-request token attribution for multi-model routing". canary repo and CI job created.

carl: action items: mei draft RFC + schema (token-envelope.v1); raja implement request_id propagation in batcher; dorit add billing consumer spike and sample dashboards. reconvene Fri 11am PT. :thumbsup:
